headword: {年末調整|ねんまつちょうせい}

definitions.explanation: The process by which employers reconcile the income tax withheld from employees' salaries throughout the year with the actual tax owed, typically done in December. Results in either a refund or additional deduction.

examples.japanese: {年末調整|ねんまつちょうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Submit the year-end tax adjustment documents.

examples.japanese: {年末調整|ねんまつちょうせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{還付金|かんぷきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I got a refund from the year-end tax adjustment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦{控除|こうじょ}→控除：07501_koujo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年末調整|ねんまつちょうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: The insurance premium deduction certificate is needed for year-end tax adjustment.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧ (year-end) + ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧ (adjustment)

TAX SYSTEM NOTES:
In Japan, employers withhold estimated income tax (⟦{源泉徴収|げんせんちょうしゅう}→源泉徴収：04908_gensenchoushuu⟧) from monthly salaries. {年末調整|ねんまつちょうせい} reconciles the total withheld with actual tax liability, accounting for:
- {生命保険料控除|せいめいほけんりょうこうじょ} (life insurance deduction)
- ⟦{扶養控除|ふようこうじょ}→扶養控除：23325_fuyoukoujo⟧ (dependent deduction)
- {住宅ローン控除|じゅうたくろーんこうじょ} (mortgage deduction)
